column1: # Malaysia, JAKIM e-solat: 13 fitted zones (SBH06 excluded, its 2026 table has internal breaks).
# Fit on each zone's 2025 table (a public mirror of e-solat, api.waktusolat.app), test forward in
# time on its own 2026 e-solat table (a better split than profiles-tested.md's "fit one year, test
# the other, both directions", which let the held-out year decide the pad). Checked at each zone's
# own unit (lat/lon empty): WLY01 and SGR01 share Selangor's two start points, PHG06 its -2.5 deg
# horizon, KTN01 its 17 deg Isha, all in the registry, not here (R41).
# PLS01's fit row is a "-clean" copy (its own note explains the one row dropped), same pattern as
# bn-mora.tsv: the archive row is never edited, only copied and filtered locally.
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): e-solat's imsak (Subuh - 10) is a precaution these files do not
# hold; the fast begins at Subuh, so the Fajr column is also checked as the end of eating (F+E), with
# the recorded limit in Jakim.kt (each zone's Subuh is printed for its latest point).
